analogy.rationale: BCL inhibitors block anti-apoptotic BCL2 family proteins, but these cells are not selected for BCL2 dependence and 6-24 h mRNA changes from apoptosis induction are modest; MDM inhibitors and caspase activators also engage the intrinsic apoptosis axis, while proteasome and HSP inhibitors cause overlapping proteotoxic/apoptotic stress programs.
